steps.title: Check Git and Node
steps.body: Git and the current Node LTS are required.
steps.verifierLabel: Git and Node respond with version numbers

steps.title: Install pnpm
steps.body: The blocking engine is built with pnpm.
steps.command:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.npm-global/bin"
npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.npm-global" pnpm
grep -qsxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.zshrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.zshrc"
export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"
steps.verifierLabel: pnpm responds with a version number

expect.prompt: In the shell, has `npm install -g pnpm` finished — a summary line such as "added 1 package" or "changed 1 package", with the prompt back and no error? Answer not done while it is still downloading, or if it stopped on a permissions error such as EACCES.

hints: If npm refused for lack of permission, reinstall Node from nodejs.org rather than re-running this with more privileges.
Finished but still not found? Open a fresh shell window so the new PATH is picked up.

steps.title: Copy NoScroll to this Mac
steps.command:
cd ~
if [ ! -d noscroll/.git ]; then
git clone https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/noscroll.git
fi

steps.title: Open the noscroll folder
steps.verifierLabel: Your terminal prompt is inside the noscroll folder

steps.title: Use the reviewed version
steps.command:
(
if ! git config --get remote.origin.url 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#^git@github\.com:#https://github.com/#; s#\.git$##' | grep -qxF "https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/noscroll"; then
  echo "~/noscroll already exists and is not a clean copy of this app's source. Move or rename that folder, then press Try again."
  exit 1
fi
if git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
  echo "~/noscroll already exists and is not a clean copy of this app's source. Move or rename that folder, then press Try again."
  exit 1
fi
git checkout 7d1c27ae8e11c551c1c11f82125a29b3f9bbf505
)

steps.title: Install the engine's dependencies
steps.verifierLabel: The command finishes without an error

steps.title: Check the blocking rules still work
steps.body: 42 tests over saved copies of the sites. Failures mean the rules need a fix.

expect.prompt: Does the terminal show a finished vitest run reporting 42 tests passed with no failing tests?

hints: If it says the engine has no node_modules, run the install step above again — it must finish without an error first.
A failing test names the rule file to fix; docs/RULES.md in the repo explains the format.

steps.title: Build the engine into both apps
steps.body: Compiles the engine and copies it, with the rule files, into both phone projects.
steps.verifierLabel: It prints "engine + rules synced to both shells"

expect.prompt: Does the terminal show the line "engine + rules synced to both shells" followed by a byte count?

hints: If node is not recognised, the Node install from setup didn't finish — reopen the terminal and check `node --version`.
If it stops on the build line, the engine's dependencies did not install; go back two steps.

steps.title: Install Android Studio
steps.body: It brings the Android tools and Java with it. Open it once and let it finish setup.
steps.verifierLabel: Android Studio opens to its welcome screen

steps.title: Open the android folder in it
steps.body: Choose Open, then pick the android folder inside noscroll. Let it finish syncing.
steps.verifierLabel: Android Studio finishes syncing without an error

point.descriptor: the Open button on Android Studio's welcome screen

steps.title: Turn on USB debugging
steps.body: Settings, About phone, tap Build number 7 times. Then Developer options, USB debugging.

steps.title: Press Run
steps.body: Connect with a USB cable, accept the phone's debugging prompt, pick it in the menu, hit Run.
steps.verifierLabel: NoScroll appears in your app list

point.descriptor: the green Run button in Android Studio's toolbar, at the top right

steps.title: Check that it works
steps.body: Open NoScroll — a simple wrapper is correct on Android. Sign in to Instagram: no Reels icon.
steps.verifierLabel: There is no Reels icon in the row along the bottom
